notes.title: Triton Survival 1.0 is Here!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Triton Survival has officially launched its 1.0 version!

[previewyoutube=rpDgqZhOAgk;full][/previewyoutube]

After a long journey through development and Early Access, the game is now complete and ready for you to experience the full adventure. Thank you to all the players who supported us along the way—your feedback and passion helped shape what Triton Survival is today.

Now it’s time to explore, build, fight, and survive like never before.

Join us and start your journey across the stars today!

Family Devs.

notes.title: Alpha 5 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of Alpha 5 for Triton Survival! This update brings a ton of new features, improvements, and optimizations to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

[b]New Features & Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Sentinel System: A brand-new bot with scanning, mining, and attack capabilities.
[*] Sentinel Function Controls: Enable or disable specific Sentinel functions through its menu.
[*] New Items: A variety of new items have been added to enrich your survival journey.
[*] Vehicle Crafting Components: New parts introduced for vehicle construction.
[*] Vehicle Crafting: Players can now craft vehicles to navigate the hostile environment more efficiently.
[*] Improved Vehicle Reception Base: Enhancements to the base where vehicles arrive.
[*] New Enemies: Additional enemy types added to challenge your survival skills.
[*] Enemy Nests: New enemy nests scattered throughout the world for increased encounters.
[/list]

[b]Planetary & Gameplay Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Planet Triton & Planet Larisa Improvements: Certain environments have been modified to improve the overall planetary experience.
[*] Wave System Enhancements: Improved mechanics for enemy waves.
[*] Storage Container Inventory Improvements: Optimized inventory management for storage containers.
[*] Improved Object Persistence Across Planets: Objects placed on different planets will now save and load more reliably.
[/list]

This update marks another step in refining and expanding Triton Survival, and we can’t wait for you to try it out! As always, we appreciate your feedback, so let us know what you think and report any issues you encounter.

Family Devs.

notes.title: Family Devs Takes the Helm: Triton Survival Under New Management
notes.notes:
We at Family Devs are thrilled to announce that we have taken the reins of Triton Survival, the adrenaline-pumping survival game previously overseen by DreamsSoftGames. With this exciting transition, we're diving headfirst into the project, fueled by a passion for gaming and a commitment to delivering an exceptional experience to our community.

[previewyoutube=iNxyENjUILQ;full][/previewyoutube]


Triton Survival, currently available in Early Access on Steam, has captivated players with its immersive world and intense gameplay. Now, under our guidance, we aim to elevate the game to new heights, incorporating fresh ideas, enhancing features, and polishing every aspect to ensure a memorable gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/e104a5f345afebc302dbd9005dca2219d96a3536.png[/img]

Our approach to development is centered around community collaboration. We recognize the invaluable input and feedback from our players, and we're eager to work closely with you all to shape the future of Triton Survival. Together, we'll embark on this journey to refine the game, listening to your suggestions, addressing concerns, and implementing changes that resonate with the community's vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/72884ddd11c693216871f3b6b66e506b926466e5.png[/img]

As we strive towards the full release of Triton Survival version 1.0, our team is committed to transparency and open communication. We'll keep you updated on our progress through regular development updates, devlogs, and community discussions. Your involvement and support are integral to the success of this project, and we're grateful for the opportunity to collaborate with such a passionate and dedicated community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/fefb38c04a07ca7fffdd08b736c2f1e0a81965ee.png[/img]

Join us as we embark on this adventure with Triton Survival. Together, let's create something truly special. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support!

Sincerely,
Family Devs.

notes.title: Update 4.1 & New Team Members
notes.notes:
Hi community,

A new [b]Triton Survival[/b] Update is available!

In this [b]Update 4.1[/b] we've added new content:

- A new [b]enemy[/b], the alien spider

- [b]Beacons[/b] to mark points of interest on the Triton map

- A [b]shield[/b] to protect the intergalactic portal

- New items for crafting [b]vehicles[/b]

- New [b]environments[/b]

- [b]More[/b] enemies in some areas

Some bugs have also been fixed:

- Item loss with inventory of [b]containers[/b] 

- Item loss with inventory of [b]extractor resources[/b]

- Item loss from the [b]hot bar[/b]

- Improved [b]character physics[/b]

Thanks to all players who send us feedback via Steam forums or email. We really appreciate your comments and suggestions.

We're still working hard on the development of Triton Survival.

I'm happy to share with you some [b]news[/b]: since a few months we're [b]3 members[/b] in the team. 

For a long time I have been a solo developer but... My [b]2 sons[/b] finished their higher studies and joined the [b]DreamsSoftGames[/b] team. We're very happy and motivated!

We'll be announcing fresh news soon...

Best wishes.
DreamsSoftGames Team.

notes.title: Alpha 4 released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/4940891e4fc987b88e01441b50efedb309d512f7.png[/img]
I'm very happy to achieve another of the goals in the development of my game. After several months of hard work, today I launch the Alpha 4.0.

The main features of this version are:

[list]
[*] New [b]locations[/b], points of interest, and more [b]loot [/b]zones across the sceneries.

[*] [b]Farming [/b]and [b]Cooking[/b]: This version increases the ability to obtain food resources from Triton, allowing you to plant vegetables and fruit trees. Likewise, a microwave oven can be crafted to combine different foods and increase their nutritional capacity.

[*] New [b]items[/b] and new tutorial [b]missions[/b] to learn the basic survival processes.

[*] Some [b]melee weapons[/b].

[*] New [b]grenades [/b](magnetic grenade and energy shield).

[*] Many small details and bug fixes.
[/list]

I keep working hard on the project. My best wishes!.

notes.title: Alpha 4.0
notes.notes:
ALPHA 4.0
- Added new locations, points of interest and loot zones on the sceneries.
- Added Shield grenade item: deploy an energy shield that protects you from enemies and their shots.
- Added Magnetic grenade item: deploy an magnetic field that attract enemies.
- Added Melee weapon: sword, axe and wooden stick.
- Added Storm Blaster. It will shoot the powered bullets as ammo, with higher damage capacity.
- New quests added: basic movement, jetpack controls, gather tools, melee weapons, food and water.
- New items added: rope, crude oil, crude oil container, kerosene, rubber.
- Added puddles on stage to extract crude oil.
- Added some dynamic clouds in the sky.
- Added item finder on crafting menu, into the inventory menu.
- Added Zoom +/- map controls ingame.
- Added Electromagnetic microwave item. This item will be a device that will allow you to cook food from consumable items to reduce your hunger and thirst for their intake.
- Added Meat cooked item (reduce your thirst. From now on eating raw meat will slightly reduce your health).
- Added Beef stew with carrots (It will reduce your hunger).
- New items added: Abduscan infusion , coffe, carbonated water, energy drink (reduce your thirst).
- Added fruits and vegetables and the possibility of crafting plantations with their seeds: orange tree, watermelon, potatoes, asparagus, apples, carrots.
- Added option to be able to delete your games and free save slots in the main menu.
- Now some plants will provide different resources: fiber, resin and rubber.
- Two experimental planets to travel through the portal: Larisa and Proteo.
- Added new resources on Larisa planet: Aluminium and Nickel.
- Fixed some issues with sheath/unsheath weapons.
- More balanced generation of resources when loading the different areas (rocks, vegetation, guano, ...)
- Fixed bug: when player dies your Shield/Armor is repaired to his maximum.
- Fixed lighting bug when load game on night.
- Fixed some shaking issues when hitting certain rocks and minerals.
- Fixed bug: Power wire color is updated when generator is on.

notes.title: Alpha 4 will be released on February 11, 2021!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/ec5bc73c5bec1b9569c83e1b8a0ad2616d33e59a.png[/img]
I have already scheduled the release date of the new Alfa 4.0. It will be on February 11, 2021.

The Alfa 2.0 expanded the size of the sceneries, which enabled the exploration of Triton to be enhanced, new locations were added and the possibility of traveling with an armed vehicle was added.

The Alpha 3.0 expanded construction capabilities of your base, from the most primitive structures (with simpler and less resistant materials) to the most advanced structures (with more elaborate materials and with greater resistance).

The Alpha 4.0 will add new locations, points of interest, and more loot zones across the stage. It will enhance the farming abilities to obtain food resources as well as the ability to crafting more processed and nutritious food.

It will also add new items and missions, new offensive and defensive weapons, such as melee weapons. It will improve the initial tutorial to learn the basic survival processes, it will incorporate the ability to delete old games and many other new aspects.

DreamsSoftGames.

Agriculture will require the planting, irrigation, fertilization and harvesting of vegetables and fruit trees. These resources will can be combined to obtain foods that provide more nutrients to satisfy hunger and thirst in a greater proportion.

Best regards!

DreamsSoftGames

notes.title: Alpha 3 released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/6982d19c61de21b3dcad6655f1ab9a402f495d30.jpg[/img]

We are very happy to achieve another of the goals in the development of our game. After several months of hard work, today we launch the Alpha 3.0.

As we anticipated, this version is focused on building your bases around the portal, which will allow to give good protection to all the structures you have created, such as light generators, resource containers, lights and other elements.

Of course, nothing will prevent you from being able to build structures in other areas of Triton or even on other planets, when they are implemented, allowing you to have several bases to store resources, vehicles, weapons or other elements that may be useful to you in these places.

You will be able to build more primitive structures (with simpler and less resistant materials) until you get more advanced structures (with more elaborate materials and with greater resistance), as you improve your player level and get enough resources.

Of course, we will continue working to improve and incorporate more structures in the following versions of the game.

We continue to work hard. Our best wishes!

DreamsSoftGames.

notes.title: Alpha 3 will be released on April 8, 2020!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/034c6f1f322420458a6594d7b3c02ab8387ecd5b.png[/img]
We have already scheduled the release date of the new Alfa 3.0. It will be on Wednesday, April 8, 2020.

The Alfa 2.0 expanded the size of the sceneries, which enabled the exploration of Triton to be enhanced, new locations were added and the possibility of traveling with an armed vehicle was added.

The Alpha 3.0 manages to enhance the building capabilities of your base. From the most primitive structures (with simpler and less resistant materials) to the most advanced structures (with more elaborate materials and with greater resistance) you will allow to give good protection to the Portal of Triton against invasions by enemy waves.

As the player improves his level and his abilities, he can create more advanced structures. The resistance to the attacks of enemy hordes will be greater and will allow a better protection of your Portal.

Since there is no limitation of buildable areas on stage, you can create structures wherever you want. This will allow you to have other bases in other parts of the planet and other planets, with your energy systems, resource extraction, storage and defense.

We continue working so that Alpha 3.0 can be liked by all who follow our project.

DreamsSoftGames.

notes.title: Development Blog#17
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/0e842abd509d4840b18ccc77e6480a6cd33de21b.jpg[/img]
We continue with the development of the Alfa 3.0, that we want to launch in a few weeks.

We are paying special attention to getting a good initial amount of structures, currently grouped into 3 technological levels: wood, iron and steel. As your player increases his level, you can access the construction of more advanced structures, but also that will require more resources and more complex.

It will also be necessary to increase your skills in fields such as technology level or construction level in order to unlock these more advanced construction structures.

We are also working on a damage and repair system of each of these structures,  that shows with particles the severity of their status, with smoke, sparks or fire. In addition, to add greater realism, all of them will be broken into pieces that will have realistic physics, which will bring more fun to the construction and destruction of structures.

The enemy attacks and also their projectiles will reduce the shield of each of these structures, showing their damage but also allowing repairs if we have the necessary resources (for example, wood to repair the first wooden structures).

We keep working hard. Soon we will give you more details.

notes.title: Small setbacks!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/3d00567f4005bbabfd514db0321eb7f6219fb553.jpg[/img]
Due to medical problems we are not reporting the progress of the game as often as we would like. However, beta 3.0 is on the right way. We have already integrated into the game a large part of the structures with which the player can build his base as he progresses in the game. First they will be wooden structures, fragile and primitive but effective to overcome the first waves. As you progress in the game and the enemies become more powerful and with greater destructive capacity you will need to create metal structures, with automatic doors. Later you will can use reinforced steel to create large metal walls that will be almost impassable by enemies.

We hope to be able to continue reporting progress and launch beta 3.0 as soon as possible allowing us the health complications that now prevent us from moving faster. Thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Working on the Alfa 3.0

Hello, we have finished and started this new year 2020 working very hard in the next version of the game: the Alpha 3.0.

The Alfa 2.0 allowed to explore a world 20 times bigger than the previous one. The Alfa 3.0 will allow a remarkable improvement in the construction system of bases and structures, from the most primitive structures (with simpler and less resistant materials) to the most advanced structures (with more elaborate materials and with greater resistance).

As the player improves his level and his abilities, he can create more advanced structures. The resistance to the attacks of enemy hordes will be greater and will allow a better protection of your Portal.

Since there is no limitation of buildable areas on stage, you can create structures wherever you want. This will allow you to have other bases in other parts of the planet and other planets, with your energy systems, resource extraction, storage and defense.

Little by little we will be giving more details about the progress we have made in alpha 3.0.

We continue working hard! Best regards

DreamsSoftGames Team

notes.title: Alpha 2.1 released!
notes.notes:
Hi, Alpha 2.1 is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/809b89afacfaedf6aea46c442aea3a86a91bbbd0.png[/img]

The most important features are:

- EXPERIMENTAL: integrated lighter skybox system to improve performance, eliminating climatic effects at the moment. In future versions you can choose this version or a more complex one through the graphic options menu.
- Added the "Water Purifycator". You must place it near water and it will extract potable water from contaminated water of Triton.
- Added the "Nitrogenator". It will extract nitrogen from air liquid of Triton.
- Added UI for "Water Purifycator" and "Nitrogenator" (similar operation to "Oxygenator").
- Improvements in the management of the generation of fish and bird banks to improve performance
- Modification of many static elements to improve performance and reduce the number of render DrawCalls.
- Increased initial vehicle ammo: 100 bullets of a maximum of 100.
- Electric generators consume 6 times less fuel. If there are no devices connected, the fuel consumption is zero.
- Resource Extractor consume 3 times less fuel.
- Added fx smoke when some tree fall.
- Added text info 'M' open map on Controls Menu
- Fixed tree mass when it fall.
- Fixed shader bug on electric connectors.
- Fixed vanadium ore scale.
- Fixed bug with car lights.
- fixed bug: cursor does not appear while the game is loading
- fixed bug: eliminated on the inventory overlapping descriptive texts of items that require skill level achieved.

NOTE: Alpha 2 is not compatible with Alpha 1 and progress will be lost.

We continue working hard! Best regards

DreamsSoftGames Team

notes.title: Alpha 2.0 released!
notes.notes:
Hi, we're happy because Alpha 2.0 is released!

This version incorporates a lot of new content. The most important features are:

- Migration game engine to 2019 version.
- Triton has been completely remodeled and now it's 20x times bigger.
- New scenaries elements: trees, bushes, alien vegetation, rocks,...
- First vehicle added with improvement options through the vehicle inventory menu (improvements in fuel, engine, lights, weapons, batteries, ...).
- Added a new enemy: flying drones.
- Added new sea fauna/enemies: sharks and snakes.
- Added new resources: Gold, Cobalt, Chromium, Tin, Hidrazine (used like fuel on some vehicles).
- Added a new item: Hydrogen container (if you use it near a hydrogen gas pump, this resource will be added to your inventory). 
- Added new electronic items: capacitor, electric coil, transistor, tin for welding, gold connector and microprocessor.
- New defensive structure: wooden barricade.
- Added teleport system activated by sacred runes. Throughout the stage, different runes and teleporters are located that will allow travel to the existing asteroids in the atmosphere of Triton.
- New HUD system.
- Looting containers added: now you will find some loot in planets locations.
- Added stamina limitation system. Hunger, thirst and poor health will affect your maximum stamina. Therefore, you will get tired before if you are hungry, thirsty or your health is weak, due to impacts, radiation, temperature or other factors.
- map feature added. Pressing 'M' key you will see a planet map.
- Now you can stack a maximum of 999 ammo 'vulcan 9mm powered' (before only 500).
- Added planet name on "Load game button" in main menu.
- Now less resources will be needed to build wooden and metal walls, thus facilitating the construction of existing structures in the game.
- Inventary size increased to 30 slots.
- Added prevention system so that the camera does not penetrate under the ground.
- Fixed size of the item graphic sulfuric acid.
- Fixed a bug with drone base menu. Now show the cursor and you can interact with it.
- Fixed a conflict between Run mode and Repair mode.
- Fixed a bug: drone transport base doesn't use countdown counter item.
- fixed minor bugs.

NOTE: This version is not compatible with Alpha 1 and progress will be lost.

We continue working hard! Best regards

DreamsSoftGames Team

notes.title: Development Blog#16

We already have a release date of our Alpha 2.0. It will be on November 26, 2019, coinciding with the start of the Steam autumn sales campaign. This will allow to benefit from a launch discount to all those who buy the game for the first time.

The Alpha 2.0 focuses mainly on the main stage: the Triton planet. We have created a new planet with an extension 30 times higher than the original Triton. Although we will continue to incorporate more elements in the next updates, we have already located some places of interest to explore the planet.

Due to its greater length, we have also incorporated the first vehicle, which will allow you to move more quickly through the scenery, provided you get the necessary resources, such as fuel, ammunition or energy for its batteries. You can also improve many aspects of your vehicle, such as lighting, engine, chassis shield, battery or ammo storage, among other aspects.

Although we will give more details in future blogs, we have also incorporated new resources on the planet, a system of teleporters and portals activated by runes, some new flora and fauna and also the first planet you can travel to: Larisa.

We continue working so that Alpha 2.0 can be liked by all who follow our project.

notes.title: Development Blog#15

Our goal is to have it completed for the next update. Once we get it we will be prepared to begin localizate the game in many other languages.

This is a complicated task, as it requires updating all the information of the game such as the game items, the info texts that make up the initial tutorial of the game, in addition to all the elements that make up the game's interface.

Once this work is achieved we plan to ask the community for your help. We want to ask for collaboration from those who want to see the game translated in their language. It will be ideal to have knowledge of English to be able to make a good translation of the text. We will also ask for help to correct our texts in English, as it is not our native language and may contain some inaccuracies. All help will be welcome.

Soon we will request your collaboration through a message that we will leave posted on the Steam forums.

Hello community!

This week we want to talk about the characteristics of the Interplanetary Portal. The objective of the game is based on protecting the Portal from enemy invasions and also using the Portal to travel to other planets and destroy their bases and their Portals.

POWER CHARGE SYSTEM:
The interstellar Portal has an amount of energy, but it is necessary to increase this energy to travel to other planets. The amount of energy needed will vary depending on the distance to the planet.

The Portal has some slots that allow the insertion of uranium batteries that supply energy. You must collect uranium and charge them for these batteries to work. You should check periodically the amount of fuel they have to recharge them.

SELF-DEFENSIVE SYSTEM:

You should know that the Portal will consume energy when traveling through it. But it will also consume energy if its self-defense system is activated. Each time an enemy approaches the Portal, a beam of energy will be automatically activated that will kill the enemy, but also consume energy from the Portal. Therefore, one of your objectives will be to protect the perimeter of the Portal so that no enemy can access it.

We continue working hard. Best regards!

Hello community

This week, among other aspects of the game, we have been working on the crafting ability. We have incorporated the crafting menu into the main inventory menu so that we can craft some basic elements on it.

Additionally we are creating some elements that allow us to perform other types of specialized crafting, such as a 'particle accelerator' to be able to divide the molecules of some elements and obtain their basic chemical compounds (such as oxygen, hydrogen and others). These basic chemical elements will allow to create other more complex chemical elements. For example we can create sulfuric acid (with chemical formula H2SO4) combining 2 hydrogen atoms (H), 1 sulfur atom (S) and 4 atoms of oxygen (O) that we will obtain from other elements or extracted minerals and resources of the subsoil. We hope that this 'chemical crafting' allows a greater variety and complexity in this important aspect of survival games.

We continue working hard. Best regards!

Hi community,

Triton is a rich planet in minerals and resources. The game will allow to obtain not only the resources that are on the surface of the planet, also those that are in the layers of the subsoil.

Initially you will be able to obtain the resources of the surface by hitting the rocks and minerals that you find. As you progress in the game you will be able to manufacture blasters that will allow you to extract resources with greater comfort and speed.

To extract the resources from the subsoil you must build mechanical extractors. These gadgets will allow you to drill the subsoil and get the precious resources. First you will be able to know the different minerals that exist below the position of the extractor and the depth to which they are. You must supply fuel to the extractor to make it work and select the depth of drilling, depending on the resource you want to extract.

We continue working hard. Best regards!

Hi community,

This week we are working on the progression of the character that will have a system to improve skills through experience points. As in other games of the genre, each action will have a reward in experience points that will raise the level of the player. Each time your level increases you will receive points for unlocking your character's abilities.

You will be able to improve a wide range of abilities of your player that will improve your capacity of resistance, displacement, strength, agility and others. You will improve the characteristics of your jetpack, your armor, your resistance to hunger or thirst, radiation or temperature. You will also improve your health and reduce your fatigue by performing different actions.

Also, level progression will allow unlocking a technological tree to be able to crafting increasingly complex elements of construction, storage, weapons, vehicles and others.

Ultimately we want to get that as you progress in the game and as you dedicate hours of your time your character is getting better. You will need it, beacuse  the invasions of Triton will be increasingly lethal.

We continue working hard. Best regards!

notes.title: Development Blog#02
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34321103/74946b2dab7ed0eb571fed1eb98be4bb391e910e.png[/img]
Hi community,

This week we have been working on the integration and features of the jetpack. The jetpack will significantly improve your movement dynamics in the planet Triton. The jetpack will allow you to run at high speed, make great jumps and even fly, reaching inaccessible areas, such as the floating asteroids of Triton's atmosphere.

All aspects of the jetpack will can be improved as the level of experience of your player increases, which will allow the speed of displacement is higher, the height of your jumps is higher, the warm-up speed of your jetpack decreases or let it cool more quickly.

We have also been working on the graphical interface that will be shown on the screen, which will give you warnings of the jetpack's warm-up, of what moments you can activate it and which keys you should use, so that you are informed at all times about these aspects.

As in other aspects, we will listen to the community during the Early Access period so that you can give us your feedback about the jetpack and the improvement proposals that you want to contribute.

We continue working hard. Best regards!

notes.title: Today we start our journey together!
notes.notes:
Today is a special day. We started the process of showing the community the project we are currently working on. Through these pages we will inform about the progress and improvements that we are incorporating to Triton Survival.

At the moment we have enabled this page on Steam, our website ([url=www.dreamssoftgames.com]DreamsSoftGames[/url]) and our ([url=https://twitter.com/dreamssoftgames]DreamsSoftGames Twitter[/url]).

Triton Survival will have many of the elements present in other games of the genre, but one of our objectives is to enhance the action and give greater meaning to the need to explore and collect resources from the planet. Little by little we will provide more details.

We plan to launch the alpha 0 version the summer of 2019 (we hope we can do it in June, if everything progresses correctly). That moment will be the beginning of our early accees stage in which we will work as much as possible to complete the game as soon as possible with the quality we want for it.

We hope to have the support of the community to pulish the game and to try to incorporate your feedback that contribute to making the game even better.

We will inform you on a regular basis of all the progress we make up to the launch of the game in early access and to complete the final version. For that we need your help!.
